meta.title: FERRA, a survival and automation game | Izacki
meta.description: FERRA is a free survival and automation game for Windows: protect your campfire, automate your production, get ready for the meteorite.
meta.imageAlt: FERRA, a survival and automation game: the title and the “Free” and “In the Izacki Launcher” mentions over a capture of the game.

hero.lead: A world to rebuild, a fire to protect, a meteorite to face. Mine, automate, defend your camp, and get ready for the night.
hero.plateAlt: FERRA banner, a survival and automation game: “A world to rebuild, a fire to protect, a meteorite to face.”, with the “Free” and “In the Izacki Launcher” mentions, over a capture of the game.

presentation.label: Overview
presentation.title: Build tile by tile.
presentation.p1: Every FERRA run is built tile by tile. Protect your campfire, gather iron, wood, stone and copper, then automate everything with drills, classic or electric, powered by an electrical grid.
presentation.p2: By day, you gather and build. At night, monsters roam. In the distance, a meteorite approaches: bunker or evacuation, your choice.
presentation.coverAlt: Illustration of FERRA: the title on a metal plate, in front of a factory of pipes, drills and conveyor belts, with a wind turbine and trees in the background.

features.label: In the game
features.title: What FERRA contains.
features.note: The names of buildings, skills and modes are those of the game, which is in French.

harvest.title: Gathering and automation
harvest.text: Gather wood, stone, iron and copper, then use classic or electric drills to automate production.

power.title: Electrical grid
power.text: Solar panels, wind turbines, generators, a nuclear plant, batteries and a Central power your machines.

skills.title: Skills and jobs
skills.text: A skill tree (Combat, Mineur, Bûcheron, Transport, Confort) and five jobs: Bûcheron, Mineur, Pêcheur, Fermier, Ingénieur.

daynight.title: Day, night and weather
daynight.text: The day/night cycle brings night monsters. The weather changes: rain, strong wind, light snow, blizzard, storm, fog, eclipse.

defense.title: Defense
defense.text: Turrets, barracks and a torch to hold out until morning.

meteor.title: The meteorite
meteor.text: A meteorite threatens the world. You choose between Bunker Tycoon, an isometric bunker to fit out, and the Évacuation.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.text: Achievements spread over seven categories, with Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers.
